ModMetadata.Name: Higher Capacity Transformers
ModMetadata.Author: aspctt
ModMetadata.Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/jk30RgFP/Steam-Workshop-Description-Seperator.png[/img]
Higher Capacity Transformers raises the output limits of the Medium and Large Transformers to match the cables they feed. A Medium Transformer now goes up to 100 kW, the most heavy cable can carry, and a Large one up to the 500 kW of super-heavy cable. Their dials move in bigger steps to match, so turning one all the way up does not take all day.
The Small Transformer stays as it is, since normal cable stops at its 5 kW anyway.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/5g0kVxCq/Steam-Workshop-Contents-Seperator.png[/img]
[b]Medium Transformer[/b], standard and reversed
[list] [*]Maximum output: 25,000 W → 100,000 W [*]Steps: 100 W → 500 W [*]Small steps: 10 W → 50 W [/list]
[b]Large Transformer[/b]
[list] [*]Maximum output: 50,000 W → 500,000 W [*]Steps: 1,000 W → 5,000 W [*]Small steps: 100 W → 500 W [/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kgbKsVv6/Steam-Workshop-Compatibility-Seperator.png[/img]
[b]Requires:[/b] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url]
✓ Existing saves, as transformers already built pick up the new limits when the save loads ✓ Removing it later, as transformers set above the game's limits drop back to them ✖ Other mods that change these transformers' limits, since only one of them can win
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Qv3yXZFh/Steam-Workshop-Issues-Bugs-Seperator.png[/img] [list] [*]See if the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*]If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*]Always post your logs: BepInEx/LogOutput.log in the game folder, and Player.log in %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Rocketwerkz/rocketstation. [*]Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*]If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the [url=https://github.com/aspctt/stationeers-higher-capacity-transformers]GitHub repository[/url]. [*]Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Mlie]Mlie[/url] for this list [/list]
